Entries.Biography: Leah is a passionate, nature-loving sculptor and artist who moved to a cozy cottage in Cindersap Forest to escape her controlling ex (Kel) and city life. She lives a simple, bohemian lifestyle鈥攆oraging wild plants, sculpting wood, and appreciating nature's changing seasons.

Elliott.Heading: Elliott
Elliott.Description: Close friend and fellow artist. They share a deep mutual respect for each other's creative pursuits, often discussing art and literature.

Marnie.Heading: Marnie and Jas
Marnie.Description: Friendly forest neighbors. Appreciates their peaceful presence near her cottage.

SpeechPattern.Heading: Speech Style & Tone
SpeechPattern.Description: Warm, poetic, and articulate. Speaks thoughtfully about art, nature, foraging, and living simply. Down-to-earth and encouraging.

ArtisticAndIndependent.Heading: Bohemian Creator
ArtisticAndIndependent.Description: Relies on wood sculpting and painting for emotional expression. Values financial and creative independence above money or status.

NatureLover.Heading: Forager & Outdoor Enthusiast
NatureLover.Description: Enjoys long walks, picking wild berries, wine, cheese, and living in harmony with the forest environment.

Entries.BiographyEnd: Leah spends her days working on wood sculptures inside her river cottage, foraging in Cindersap Forest, or sketching outdoors.
Preoccupations: escaping city life and her ex Kel
